data.narrative:
Applied Atomics is a Seed-stage nuclear energy company founded by Ben Kellie and Paul Keutelian that has raised $8M to date. The nuclear energy sector includes 3 public comps (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private comps, including peers such as Nano Nuclear Energy, Oklo, X-Energy, Fuse Energy, and Exodys Energy.

The stage-progression method is the applicable triangulation approach here. Using total capital raised ($8M) as a valuation proxy and applying a typical Seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 2.5x yields an implied valuation of $20M. The peer-median method is not applicable due to insufficient comparable data points within narrow filters (same-stage or adjacent-stage nuclear peers); while 4 same-sector peers exist, none of the refined screens produced the minimum 3 datapoints required for reliable median derivation.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $17M to $23M, with a median point of $20M. This range reflects the single-method foundation and inherent stage-level uncertainty typical of early-stage frontier tech. Key uncertainties include the degree to which Seed-stage step-up multiples apply within the nascent nuclear subsector, the relevance of broader nuclear energy comp multiples to Applied Atomics' specific technology positioning, and the limited operating history available for fundamental benchmarking. Additional revenue or technical milestones would improve valuation precision.
